signals.label: Strait of Hormuz: ships per day (7-day avg, data to 2026-09-27)
signals.series_kind: daily n_total (ships/day, all vessel types), not smoothed
signals.means: Fewer ships through a chokepoint may mean war risk, attacks, insurance withdrawal or a blockade pushing traffic away.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove an attack or a closure: weather, seasonality, AIS gaps and the few-day data lag also move it.

signals.label: Countries with significant internet outages (48 h)
signals.note: Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cape Verde, Central African Republic, China, Congo, Federated States Of Micronesia, Haiti, Iraq, Lesotho, Lithuania, Malta, New Zealand, Nigeria
signals.means: More countries with large internet outages may mean shutdowns, attacks on networks or grid failures.
signals.not_proves: It does not tell the cause: cable cuts, power cuts and censorship all look alike here.

signals.label: US "Do Not Travel" (Level 4) countries
signals.means: A new country on the US Level 4 list means the US government sees a sharp rise in danger there.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove danger: advisories are political and change slowly.

signals.label: Shallow M4.5+ events near nuclear test sites (7 days)
signals.means: A shallow quake near a nuclear test site could be a nuclear or large conventional test.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove a test: natural quakes happen there; only CTBTO or seismologists can tell.

signals.label: FAO Food Price Index (2026-09)
signals.note: baseline = same month a year ago
signals.means: Higher world food prices raise the risk of unrest in import-dependent poor countries.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove unrest: prices follow harvests, weather and currencies.

signals.label: Satellite fire detections near major refineries/oil terminals, European Russia (last 3 days)
signals.series_kind: daily count of VIIRS fire detections within ~15 km of the sites (incl. routine gas flares)
signals.means: More satellite fire detections near big refineries may mean strikes, sabotage or accidents at energy sites.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove an attack or the site hit: gas flaring, field burning and accidents also show as fires.

signals.label: Brent spot price (2026-09-29)
signals.note: baseline = median of the previous 30 trading days
signals.means: A Brent price far above its recent level means markets price a supply risk.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove a physical shortage: speculation, OPEC decisions and the dollar move it too.

signals.label: US commercial crude stocks (ex SPR), week to 2026-09-25
signals.note: baseline = median of the previous 12 weeks; a fall is the warning
signals.series_kind: weekly ending stocks, thousand barrels (one point per week, not daily)
signals.means: Falling US crude or diesel stocks mean a tighter buffer against supply shocks.
signals.not_proves: It does not prove a crisis: stocks move with the season, refinery runs and exports.
